designs.name: Northbound
designs.blurb: Editorial and cinematic. A serif headline, big photography and a latitude ruler that follows you north from Kent to the Arctic coast.
designs.short: Editorial: serif headlines, big photographs and a latitude ruler.

designs.name: Manifest
designs.blurb: Engineered and precise. Drawn like a shipping document, with technical drawings of the products and a live board for the three yards: local time, open or closed, and the number to call.
designs.short: Engineered: product drawings and a live board for the three yards.

designs.name: Yellow
designs.blurb: Bold poster branding. UCM yellow and black, very large type, and the yard phone numbers right under the headline.
designs.short: Bold poster branding in UCM yellow and black, with very large type.

designs.name: Boreal
designs.blurb: Calm and map-first. Opens on a map of Alaska that asks where you are building and names the yard to call.
designs.short: Calm and map-first: name the place, see which yard to call.
